headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Los Angeles Angels defeated the Detroit Tigers 10-6, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge at the plate.

Several teams suffered injuries, impacting their availability for upcoming games. The Los Angeles Angels placed Nolan Schanuel on the 10-day injured list due to left ankle inflammation. The Tampa Bay Rays placed Gavin Lux on the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder impingement. The Toronto Blue Jays transferred Alejandro Kirk from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left thumb fracture.

The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash and traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Guardians 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Cade Cavalli earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays were defeated by the Baltimore Orioles with a final score of 6-1. Shane Baz pitched 7.0 innings for the Rays, striking out 9 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers in 10-6 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 10-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Vaughn Grissom leading the charge at the plate. Grissom's impressive performance included 3 hits, 1 home run, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Suffer Historic Loss to Pirates**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs were defeated by the Pittsburgh Pirates with a final score of 1-12. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Cubs' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Miami Marlins 2-1, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and Otto Lopez leading the charge for the winning team. Eury Pérez was a standout on the mound for the Marlins, but ultimately fell short.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. CJ Abrams and Chase DeLauter led the Nationals' offense, while Travis Bazzana also made an impact.

top_news.title: **Angels' Nolan Schanuel Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels first baseman Nolan Schanuel has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left ankle inflammation, with the move retroactive to May 24, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
